content: Which projects are related to computer vision?

Himanshi has a project related to computer vision called **P&ID Vision Agent**.

This project involves building a computer vision agent that can detect and analyze symbols in P&ID diagrams. It addresses the problem of time-consuming manual identification of engineering symbols by creating a vision pipeline for detection and further analysis, supporting engineering reporting.

**Key Details:**
*   **Domain:** Computer Vision
*   **Technologies:** Python, YOLO, Computer Vision, P&ID Analysis
*   **Features:** Object detection, Symbol identification, P&ID analysis, and Engineering report generation.

The project that uses YOLO is **P&ID Vision Agent**.

This computer vision agent was built to detect and analyze symbols within P&ID diagrams. It utilizes a vision pipeline where YOLO performs object detection, followed by symbol identification and relationship analysis to support engineering reporting.
